review.notes: Full review of README and Suggested.lean, plus the family index files. Sample 0.1, 0.3a, 0.3, 0.2, 1.1, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1-3.4: every numerical Check recomputed in the polynomial model (Smith forms, Gram determinants, c_Br, Fischer norms), with further adversarial tests of 0.3 (112 cases), 1.1 (1815 pairs, 50 integrality cases), 2.1 (b) (1148), 2.2 (a)/(b) (24456) and 2.2 (c) (678424); one false Check sentence found (R03). Source locators: the formal proof is cited with no locator; the announcement was read on the author's page; Jantzen not available. Automatic checks: all passed; depcheck 0 problems; Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry only; #check of all 7 declarations matches the README; one-tactic probes close nothing. A scratch file shows the sandwich and block-cut headlines are statable at the pins (R01). Supplier citations resolved on main and at the open heads of SlopesOfHermitianVectorBundles and HermitianFormsAndLattices.
